scripts.db:bootstrap-admin: node scripts/require-env.mjs .env weaver ./data -- pnpm --filter @weaver/db exec tsx prisma/bootstrap-admin.ts

scripts.db:seed: node scripts/require-env.mjs .env weaver ./data -- pnpm --filter @weaver/core exec tsx scripts/seed.ts
